pages.title: Healing — 16 uses
pages.text: When you are below full health, this talisman restores 30% of your maximum health. It can trigger once every 5 seconds.

$(bold)Speed Boost — 180 uses$()$(br)While sprinting, keeps Speed II active.$(br)$(bold)Hydrophobic — 180 uses$()$(br)When your air supply is running low, restores 40 air per tick to help you stay underwater.$(br2)$(bold)Lava Affinity — 180 uses$()$(br)When you are burning, in lava, or taking fire damage, grants Lava Affinity: faster swimming, clear vision in lava, and immunity to fire.

$(bold)Shelter — 16 uses$()$(br)If one hit would deal at least 20% of your current health, Shelter reduces that hit to exactly 20% of your current health. It has a 5-second cooldown, making it especially useful against sudden heavy attacks.
